subject: Retargeting creative claims review — benchmarks/latency/cost substantiation needed
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Lena Tran <lena@velvetcreative.co>
Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Retargeting creative v3 — ready for PMM pass
Attachments: Retargeting_Creative_Brief_v3.pdf; Redwood_Retargeting_Copy_Sheet_v3.xlsx

Soojin — can you do a quick PMM claims/wording pass on the retargeting set?

We’re planning to launch Monday AM (Week 1). Primary audience is non-activated signups (no first_success in 72h) + lapsed week-2 users.

Specific asks:
- sanity check performance/cost claims and what needs a link/footnote on landing page
- any “do/don’t” phrasing for LinkedIn + Google (developer-first tone, no hype)

Lena (Velvet) is on cc for quick edits.

Thanks,
Ben

—
Ben Carter
Growth Marketing | Redwood Inference


From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Lena Tran <lena@velvetcreative.co>
Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 10:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Retargeting creative v3 — ready for PMM pass

Thanks. I reviewed the PDF + copy sheet. Overall direction is good, but we need to tighten/qualify a few claims before we run paid.

Items that need substantiation (link on landing page OR remove/soften):

1) “2× faster inference” / “lowest latency”
- Can’t run “2×” or “lowest” without a specific baseline + public benchmark page.
- Suggest: “Low-latency inference for open models (see benchmark details)”
- If you want a number, specify model + hardware + scenario and link to the benchmark post.

2) “Save 30–40% on inference cost”
- Same issue: needs baseline. Also cost varies by batching/seq length.
- Suggest: “Reduce unit cost with batching/caching/quantization controls” + link to Optimize doc.

3) “99.99% uptime”
- I don’t believe we publicly commit 99.99% for self-serve/hosted. Unless this is an SLA for Dedicated (and even then, needs correct scope).
- Recommend removing from ads.

4) “Production-ready in 5 minutes”
- Fine as a softer promise, but “production-ready” is a loaded term. Suggest: “Get to your first successful request in minutes.”

5) “Benchmark-proven” / “verified performance profiles”
- Fine, but we should link to methodology + the specific benchmark page referenced.

Proposed approved building blocks (safe-ish):
- “Low-latency, cost-aware LLM inference.”
- “Hosted, Dedicated, or Private deployments.”
- “Streaming + observability for token-level latency/cost.”

Links we can use (please confirm they’re current/public):
- Benchmarks methodology: https://redwoodinference.com/blog/benchmarks-methodology
- Benchmarks post (if this is the one we stand behind): https://redwoodinference.com/blog/llama-3-1-inference-benchmarks
- Streaming guide: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/streaming
- Cost optimization guide: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/optimize-cost

Lena — for the final creative, please avoid absolutes (“best,” “fastest,” “cheapest”) and avoid quoting numeric improvements unless the ad/landing page includes the “what we measured” link.

Ben — can you reply with which specific benchmark table we’re pointing to and the exact model/hardware scenario? Then I can green-light a version that includes numbers.

Soojin

—
Soojin Lee
Product Marketing | Redwood Inference


From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Tran <lena@velvetcreative.co>
Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 10:27 AM PST
Subject: Re: Retargeting creative v3 — ready for PMM pass

+1 to Soojin’s notes.

For paid, I’d rather we be slightly conservative than spend the first week dealing with “you promised X” support tickets.

If we can’t back it up with a public link that explains methodology, don’t run it.

Camila

—
Camila Reyes
VP Marketing | Redwood Inference


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Lena Tran <lena@velvetcreative.co>
Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 12:14 PM PST
Subject: Re: Retargeting creative v3 — ready for PMM pass
Attachments: Benchmark_Snippets_For_Ads_v1.docx

Got it.

On substantiation: we were basing “2× faster” on an internal comparison vs a default vLLM config, but it’s not published in a way we can cleanly cite.

Proposal:
- remove “2× faster” + remove “save 30–40%” entirely for now
- keep “low-latency” + “cost-aware controls” + “streaming + token-level dashboards”
- add “See benchmark details” CTA to landing page section that links to:
  - methodology post
  - llama 3.1 inference benchmarks post

Numeric option (only if you’re comfortable):
- “p95 latency as low as ~250ms*” with asterisk that links to the benchmark post.
  *we’ll align exact number/model/hardware to what’s in the public post (no internal-only data)

I attached a quick doc with the exact lines we can pull from the benchmark post + footnote text.

Lena: can you make those edits in the copy sheet today, and keep versions without any numbers as the default?

Ben


From: Lena Tran <lena@velvetcreative.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 2:06 PM PST
Subject: Re: Retargeting creative v3 — ready for PMM pass

Yes — we’ll revise.

Plan from our side:
- Strip “2× faster,” “30–40% cheaper,” “99.99% uptime”
- Replace with:
  - “Low-latency LLM inference. Clear levers to lower unit cost.”
  - “Streaming + dashboards to debug latency/cost.”
  - “Hosted, Dedicated, or Private.”
- Add small “Benchmarks & methodology” link on landing page near the first fold.

Question: Are we okay using “benchmark-proven” if it links to the methodology post? Or should we say “benchmarks you can inspect” / “published benchmarks”?

We can send updated copy sheet EOD.

Thanks,
Lena

Lena Tran
Client Partner | Velvet Creative


From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Tran <lena@velvetcreative.co>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 17, 2025 at 2:24 PM PST
Subject: Re: Retargeting creative v3 — ready for PMM pass

“Benchmark-proven” is okay only if:
1) it links directly to the methodology post, and
2) the landing page also links to at least one concrete benchmark page/table.

But I prefer “Published benchmarks (methodology included)” or “Benchmarks you can inspect” for a developer audience.

Also please avoid “as low as ~250ms” unless the landing page shows the exact test conditions in the same scroll (model, hardware, region, input/output length). If we can’t keep those conditions close, stick to qualitative.

Approved phrasing examples:
- “Published benchmarks + a methodology you can inspect.”
- “Low-latency inference for open models. See benchmark details.”
- “Tune cost with batching/caching/quantization controls.”

Not approved:
- “Fastest / best / lowest latency”
- “Guaranteed savings”

Ben — once Lena sends the updated sheet, I’ll give final sign-off. If we need to reference the sprint analysis plan in case anyone asks, point them to PM-415 and keep the ads free of any promises we can’t measure.

Soojin


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Lena Tran <lena@velvetcreative.co>

Subject: Re: Retargeting creative claims review — benchmarks/latency/cost substantiation needed

Updated set is in (Lena applied all removals). We also updated the landing page outline to include a “Benchmarks & methodology” block above troubleshooting, with links to:
- https://redwoodinference.com/blog/benchmarks-methodology
- https://redwoodinference.com/blog/llama-3-1-inference-benchmarks
- https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/streaming
- https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/optimize-cost

We are NOT running any numeric claims in ads.

Soojin — can you confirm final approval so we can schedule the campaigns for tomorrow morning?

Ben
